method: Two-pass Codex visual review of all three original complete frames; no crops, boxes or regions were supplied to the detector.
limitations: RAD RoadDamages is broad. Only visually unequivocal events are locked; this small AI-reviewed subset is a release regression gate, not a universal accuracy claim.

diagnostic_exclusions.reason: A utility-cover repair is clear, but a nearby hood-occluded rough zone may contain shallow material loss; the near-identical viewpoints cannot establish or rule out cavity depth.
